verses.text: Save me, O God; For the waters are come in unto my soul.

segments.text: Save me, O God;
For the waters are come in unto my soul.

verses.text: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

segments.text: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing:
I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

verses.text: I am weary with my crying; my throat is dried: Mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.

segments.text: I am weary with my crying; my throat is dried:
Mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.

verses.text: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head: They that would cut me off, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: That which I took not away I have to restore.

segments.text: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head:
They that would cut me off, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty:
That which I took not away I have to restore.

verses.text: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; And my sins are not hid from thee.

segments.text: O God, thou knowest my foolishness;
And my sins are not hid from thee.

verses.text: Let not them that wait for thee be put to shame through me, O Lord Jehovah of hosts: Let not those that seek thee be brought to dishonor through me, O God of Israel.

segments.text: Let not them that wait for thee be put to shame through me, O Lord Jehovah of hosts:
Let not those that seek thee be brought to dishonor through me, O God of Israel.

verses.text: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; Shame hath covered my face.

segments.text: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach;
Shame hath covered my face.

verses.text: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, And an alien unto my mother’s children.

segments.text: I am become a stranger unto my brethren,
And an alien unto my mother’s children.

verses.text: For the zeal of thy house hath eaten me up; And the reproaches of them that reproach thee are fallen upon me.

segments.text: For the zeal of thy house hath eaten me up;
And the reproaches of them that reproach thee are fallen upon me.

verses.text: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, That was to my reproach.

segments.text: When I wept,
and chastened
my soul with fasting,
That was to my reproach.

verses.text: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword unto them.

segments.text: When I made sackcloth my clothing,
I became a byword unto them.

verses.text: They that sit in the gate talk of me; And I am the song of the drunkards.

segments.text: They that sit in the gate talk of me;
And
I am
the song of the drunkards.

verses.text: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O Jehovah, in an acceptable time: O God, in the abundance of thy lovingkindness, Answer me in the truth of thy salvation.

segments.text: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O Jehovah, in an acceptable time:
O God, in the abundance of thy lovingkindness,
Answer me in the truth of thy salvation.

verses.text: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: Let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.

segments.text: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink:
Let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.

verses.text: Let not the waterflood overwhelm me, Neither let the deep swallow me up; And let not the pit shut its mouth upon me.

segments.text: Let not the waterflood overwhelm me,
Neither let the deep swallow me up;
And let not the pit shut its mouth upon me.

verses.text: Answer me, O Jehovah; for thy lovingkindness is good: According to the multitude of thy tender mercies turn thou unto me.

segments.text: Answer me, O Jehovah; for thy lovingkindness is good:
According to the multitude of thy tender mercies turn thou unto me.

verses.text: And hide not thy face from thy servant; For I am in distress; answer me speedily.

segments.text: And hide not thy face from thy servant;
For I am in distress; answer me speedily.

verses.text: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: Ransom me because of mine enemies.

segments.text: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it:
Ransom me because of mine enemies.

verses.text: Thou knowest my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonor: Mine adversaries are all before thee.

segments.text: Thou knowest my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonor:
Mine adversaries are all before thee.

verses.text: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: And I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; And for comforters, but I found none.

segments.text: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness:
And I looked for some to take pity, but there was none;
And for comforters, but I found none.

verses.text: They gave me also gall for my food; And in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

segments.text: They gave me also gall for my food;
And in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

verses.text: Let their table before them become a snare; And when they are in peace, let it become a trap.

segments.text: Let their table before them become a snare;
And when they are in peace,
let it become
a trap.

verses.text: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they cannot see; And make their loins continually to shake.

segments.text: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they cannot see;
And make their loins continually to shake.

verses.text: Pour out thine indignation upon them, And let the fierceness of thine anger overtake them.

segments.text: Pour out thine indignation upon them,
And let the fierceness of thine anger overtake them.

verses.text: Let their habitation be desolate; Let none dwell in their tents.

segments.text: Let their habitation be desolate;
Let none dwell in their tents.

verses.text: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; And they tell of the sorrow of those whom thou hast wounded.

segments.text: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten;
And they tell of the sorrow of those whom thou hast wounded.

verses.text: Add iniquity unto their iniquity; And let them not come into thy righteousness.

segments.text: Add iniquity unto their iniquity;
And let them not come into thy righteousness.

verses.text: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, And not be written with the righteous.

segments.text: Let them be blotted out of the book of life,
And not be written with the righteous.

verses.text: But I am poor and sorrowful: Let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.

segments.text: But I am poor and sorrowful:
Let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.

verses.text: I will praise the name of God with a song, And will magnify him with thanksgiving.

segments.text: I will praise the name of God with a song,
And will magnify him with thanksgiving.

verses.text: And it will please Jehovah better than an ox, Or a bullock that hath horns and hoofs.

segments.text: And it will please Jehovah better than an ox,
Or
a bullock that hath horns and hoofs.

verses.text: The meek have seen it, and are glad: Ye that seek after God, let your heart live.

segments.text: The meek have seen it, and are glad:
Ye that seek after God, let your heart live.

verses.text: For Jehovah heareth the needy, And despiseth not his prisoners.

segments.text: For Jehovah heareth the needy,
And despiseth not his prisoners.

verses.text: Let heaven and earth praise him, The seas, and everything that moveth therein.

segments.text: Let heaven and earth praise him,
The seas, and everything that moveth therein.

verses.text: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah; And they shall abide there, and have it in possession.

segments.text: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah;
And they shall abide there, and have it in possession.

verses.text: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it; And they that love his name shall dwell therein.

segments.text: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it;
And they that love his name shall dwell therein.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician; set to Shoshannim. A Psalm of David.
